note: GROUP slip — VERIFICATION pass (prefix v-slip-). Corrections to .vicifull/recipes/slip.json: (a) `scripts/vicifull/shot.mjs --do` with .vicifull/drive.js's tap() DOES work on this build — `--do='await tap("Log the slip"); await tap("Closed"); await tap("Choose a time")'` drives /slip to 98C, and `--do='await tap("Start the interrupt")'` drives /urge past its first board. The claim in slip.json that Pressable ignores drive.js's synthetic events is wrong; .vicifull/slipshot.mjs is a convenience, not a necessity. (b) The Slip Urge Now, Dont Fail Twice, Stop Here and Third recipes omit the answer tap — 98F is drawn with `A little` SELECTED, so the step list needs "A little" before the last "Continue" or the capture reports the selected row's ring, weight, disc and check as four mismatches. (c) In zsh, `"${arr[@]}"` on an EMPTY array still passes one empty word to slipshot.mjs, which then clicks an arbitrary element — deck index 0 was captured as the wrong card until that was removed.
